pathway.title: Historical ARCC — Lite screening report
pathway.question: What requires deeper credit work in the selected historical evidence?

runs.text: CP-L10 — MIXED. Mechanism: Reported NII growth alongside PIK/collection and portfolio-deployment cash differences means aggregate earnings do not settle cash realization; matched definitions and per-share attribution are needed before a full change conclusion. Screening implication: Reported investment income and net investment income increased, while aggregate net operations stayed flat and diluted earnings fell. Cash deployment and financial-company definitions require deeper review before interpreting conversion or leverage.

CP-L20 — MIXED. Mechanism: Non-accrual movement and valuation-dependent assets can affect realized income and creditor buffers, while distributions and capital raising change retention; higher NII is contrary evidence, not a complete durability finding. Screening implication: Higher reported NII and a large invested asset base are counterweights to deterioration claims, but non-accrual movement, valuation dependence, cash realization and capital allocation remain decision-relevant. Missing ESG transmission is a request, not adverse evidence.

CP-L23 — WATCH. Mechanism: Investment-deployment cash, restricted resources and conditional facilities make timing/access decisive for funding; static rate exposure can change income without providing a timed uses plan. Screening implication: Cash and conditional facilities provide historical funding context, but portfolio deployment, restrictions and maturity uses need a timed plan. Issuer rate scenarios identify exposure; they do not prove cash sufficiency or hedge adequacy.

CP-L30 — ESCALATE_FOR_FULL_SELECTION. Mechanism: Historical evaluated levels with unresolved price/accrual convention can produce different apparent compensation; incomplete protection/depth prevents turning that signal into security preference or implementation. Screening implication: Historical evaluated observations and a material price-basis ambiguity justify targeted full market/selection work. They do not justify a preferred instrument, valuation, recovery amount, factual PD or position.

CP-L40 — WATCH. Mechanism: Selected operative clauses and asset-value-based financing constraints require event-specific terms, marks and entity coverage; incomplete records prevent a permission, capacity or compliance conclusion. Screening implication: Executed selected-note documents exist, but full entity/term/usage and transaction evidence is incomplete. Triage first to the asset-value funding constraint and missing creditor-document map; no legal, capacity or compliance conclusion is owned here.
